title: Elliptic capacity propagation and Fourier restriction to the sphere
summary: We prove the bounded-data Fourier restriction conjecture for the sphere in three dimensions: the Fourier extension operator maps $`L^\infty(S^2)`$ boundedly into $`L^p(\mathbb R^3)`$ for every p > 3. This is the full conjectured open range, and the threshold p = 3 is sharp.
family_title: Fourier restriction for positively curved surfaces

review.reason: Proves bounded-data Fourier restriction estimates for the sphere in three dimensions.
